task.title: Fix misconfigured healthcheck port in service config
task.prompt: The billing-api healthcheck probe is failing because HEALTHCHECK_PORT in config/service.env does not match LISTEN_PORT. Update config/service.env so HEALTHCHECK_PORT equals LISTEN_PORT (8443), and write the single line "8443" to healthcheck.port in the workspace root.

workspace_files.README.md:
# billing-api config

Keep `HEALTHCHECK_PORT` synchronized with `LISTEN_PORT` in `config/service.env`.
Write the active healthcheck port to `healthcheck.port` after updating.

task.verification_cmd: test -f healthcheck.port && grep -q "^8443$" healthcheck.port && grep -q "^HEALTHCHECK_PORT=8443$" config/service.env
